about_the_game:
- ARE YOU READY FOR HOT SEAT? -

Welcome to Vulkan Computing Security Systems.

Here at Vulkan, we strive to build better condor systems, to allow the world a smoother trip through the virtual realm.

We are looking to appoint a brand-new IT Technician to join the Vulkan team, to help with maintaining and updating the computing systems at the high security facility ‘QUASAR’©.

We are in need of someone who is confidant in a role that includes but is not limited to:

- Fault finding and resolution

- Has a good understanding of networks, IP addressing and voice infrastructure

- Ability to identify accurately all types of desktop hardware

- good understanding of software applications

As an Vulkan IT technician at ‘QUASAR’; it is your responsibility to adhere to the following company standards:

- promote the company ‘Vulkan’© in a positive light at all times

- be presentable and project a professional appearance at all times

- be stress free in a high stress environment at all times

- be punctual at all times

We look forward to receiving your application and hopefully welcoming you, into the Vulkan fold.

Good luck.

Mr Dirk Assmann

Head of IT

DISCLAIMER: During your shifts you are responsible for the monitoring and documentation of highly dangerous subject and high security assets. We are not liable for any injuries including: mental trauma, loss of limbs, or death.

content_descriptors.notes: Voice Acting with lines talking about drinking and drugs.

name: Hot Seat

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 or AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTC 970 or AMD RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5000 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-10900X CPU @ 3.70GHz, 3696 Mhz, 10 Core(s), 20 Logical Processor(s)
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RX 3080
  • Storage: 5000 MB available space

short_description: Hot Seat is a first person, dark comedy, narrative puzzler. Don't loose your nerve under the building tension in the Hot Seat... uncover secrets and find the truth. It's just a normal first day on the job right? VR Version also in development.
